/reversing/2017/03/20/gothenburg-malware.name: James Tucker
/reversing/2017/03/20/gothenburg-malware.message:
Great rundown. Thanks for posting it. I have a few customers asking about this 'attack', and it'll be nice to have a good rundown to link.
While this incident was uninspiring, I do think the methodology is quite interesting and has been used in more sophisticated attacks in the past.

replies.name: Zeta Two
replies.message: Thanks! Glad to hear that you find it valuable. You are completely correct in that the "candy drop", i.e. dropping USB drives near targets, technique can be, and have been, used for much more interesting attacks. The general rule to never insert unknown drives into your computer still holds of course.
